text:
jess (oncall): incident-bot alerted: spike of 502/500s hitting /v1/generate from eu-west-2 at 03:25 UTC
incident-bot: Pager P1 - API 5xx spike - 60% errors over 4m. Dash: https://grafana/redwood/d/api-5xx ; runbook: https://confluence.redwood/runbooks/api-5xx-kv-fallover
tom (sre): i'm up, taking primary. jess can you handover? i'll coordinate cross-team routing.
jess (oncall): handing primary to @tom. i'm stepping out for a quick call, will monitor briefly as secondary. current notes: customer impact visible for EU region only, rapid increase started after 03:18.
leo (runtime): runtime traces show frequent timeouts to kv-cache service and HTTP 504s bubbled up. suspect client-side retry storm. attaching snippet: ```traces: runtime->kv-cache latency 300-800ms, retried x3```
anya (infra): infra oncall here. redis-eu cluster shows high rdb bgsave CPU and blocking GC around same interval. nodes 3/5 showing top CPU >90%. I'm kicking a scale-up and enabling replica promotion.
security-oncall: tagging incident. will watch auth logs but no immediate indicators of malicious traffic.
support-oncall: opened PSR and sent initial msg to affected accounts: "We're investigating increased errors in EU; mitigation underway; ETA 30m for next update."
tom (sre): ownership/routing: runtime team handles fallback, circuit-breaker and client retry tuning; infra handles redis cluster health and scaling; security only if we see anomalous request patterns; support manages external comms. runtime oncall: leo (primary), infra oncall: anya. secondary coverage: jess (sre backup) and infra backup @ops-backup.
leo (runtime): experimenting with turning on degraded-mode: set env CACHE_READONLY=true and reduce concurrent requests to cache via `MAX_KV_CONNS=8`. rolling config change to 10% canary.
anya (infra): scaling cluster +1 node, applying tuned `save` config to avoid full rdb during peak. command: `terraform apply -var='replicas=4' -target=module.redis.eu` ETA ~2m.
jess (oncall): flagging coverage gap: APAC night window has no infra primary right now (anya is EU day). Recommend we add an infra backup for nights — @ops-lead to action.
incident-bot: Update: error rate down to 22% (was 60%). Mitigation: partial (cache degraded + infra scale).
leo (runtime): canary pods show 5xx drop to ~10% on canary. rolling out to 100% now with `kubectl rollout restart deploy/runtime -n runtime`.
anya (infra): new redis replica joined and sync is healthy per metrics. no evictions after tune.
tom (sre): quick check for security signals: security-oncall any spikes on unusual sources?
security-oncall: negative so far, normal traffic patterns. we'll keep 24hr log retention for this window.
support-oncall: sending followup to customers: "Errors reduced; we're continuing to monitor; will follow with root cause in post-incident summary."
tom (sre): next steps: keep on-call owners until M1 (stable errors <1% for 30m). schedule postmortem if root cause not purely capacity/config. runbook pointer: Confluence > Runbooks > API 5xx > KV-cache fallback and infra scaling checklist.
jess (oncall): i'll remain as secondary for the next hour for handover. tagging @ops-lead about APAC infra coverage. thanks team. :thumbsup:
